params.body:
Closes #1061

## Why

When a partner's vehicle does not get in through the API, `VehicleApiController::store` mailed the office "Stocklist Api error": the exception message, file, line and the full trace, over fifty frames of vendor paths. The mail of 31 October 2026 (#1058) was one slow request to the photo bucket, but nothing in it named the garage or the car, said the vehicle had not been created, or whether anyone had to act.

## What changes

- New `ApiVehicleNotCreatedMail`, an internal notification in Dutch in the house style of the bell report: no greeting, no closing, the subject as title.
  - Subject: "Wagen van <garage> kwam niet binnen via de API".
  - One sentence on what happened: the vehicle was not created, the partner got an error back.
  - Facts table: garage, make and model, chassis number, time (Brussels), cause.
  - The cause in words, told apart: the photo storage did not answer (transient), a partner photo could not be fetched or read, or a fault in the platform.
  - "Wat moet je doen?" per cause: wait and check, ask the garage to resend, or forward to the developer.
  - One quiet line for the developer: exception class, message and the first place in `app/` it passed. No trace, no vendor paths; the full trace stays in the log (`Log::error`).
- The controller sends this mail instead of `ErrorMail`. The recipient is unchanged (`mail.api_error_recipient`). `ErrorMail` stays for the developer mails from the exception handler.

## Tests

- `TheOfficeCanReadAnApiErrorMailTest`: the slow-bucket case renders with garage, chassis number, Belgian time, cause and next step, and without a trace or vendor path; the three causes are told apart; without a garage the subject still reads.
- `EveryMailFollowsTheHouseRulesTest` now renders this mail too, as an internal one.
- Full suite: 3186 tests; the only errors are the 6 in `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest`, which fail the same way on `origin/main`. PHPStan clean.

Source: Portal mail:37.
params.title: The API error mail tells the office what happened, not the stack
